candidate.implementation_subject: Repair retained buying-chain extraction and reassessment

retained_buying_chain: Accepted retained permits and RSS evidence automatically enqueue retained-only extraction after acceptance associations are available.
Permit evaluator versions and RSS admission policy versions are carried and checked as evidence policy identity.

Retained request identity and worker fences use project identity, accepted immutable evidence versions, and policies; derived claims and extraction runs do not invalidate unchanged requests or sibling evidence jobs.

A bounded backfill CLI defaults to dry-run, supports UUID project cursors and a maximum page size of 100, and requires --expected-database-name for --apply. Test target requires a _test database; application target is available only for a separately authorized run. No application/production apply was performed.
news_reassessment: Retained RSS reassessment defaults to rejected interpretations; accepted reassessment requires explicit --include-accepted with --apply.
Reassessment is bounded and UUID-cursor paginated, handles null publication dates, and preserves earlier decisions and policy identity/history.
Evaluator grammar version is rss-project-v7. The final holdout exposed misses; grammar was not tuned after that evaluation.

focused_pytest.result: 63 passed; one upstream Starlette/httpx deprecation warning
coverage_receipts: Accepted permit fixture processed through process_job, automatic retained job executed, contractor DIRECT role and provenance checked, HTTP retrieval forbidden, unchanged replay after worker execution created no new job, and evidence correction replaced current claim while preserving prior claim history.
Retained news assessment applied and replayed while preserving previous_decisions; UUID cursor advanced to another item with null published_at.
Backfill dry-run, bounded cursor, and apply/replay idempotency exercised against the disposable test database; database-name mismatch rejected before connection.
